newsitem.title: FRANCE: Generale des Eaux, Havas in talks over Canal Plus.
newsitem.headline: Generale des Eaux, Havas in talks over Canal Plus.

text.p: Generale des Eaux and Havas said in a joint statement on Monday that they were in talks concerning their activities in the audiovisual sector, in particular their stakes in Canal Plus.
They added that pending board meetings on February 6 they could make no comment but any deal would be based on stock market values before February 1.
An industry source had earlier said Alcatel Alsthom was in talks with Generale des Eaux to sell part of its Havas stake.
At Canal Plus there was no comment.
French newspapers have said that Havas was set to sell its stake in Canal Plus to Generale des Eaux and that the latter would take a bigger stake in Havas.
Havas has a 21.6 percent stake in pay TV group Canal Plus, Generale des Eaux has 19.2 percent, bank Societe Generale 4.5 percent and state-owned bank Caisse des Depots 6.9 percent.
Canal Plus is merging with Nethold.
